answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch-specific polynomial whose constant term encodes their secret; each valid signal carries a zero-knowledge proof of a share without exposing that secret. Reusing an identity’s rate-limit nullifier for duplicate messages in the same epoch yields distinct shares, letting observers interpolate the polynomial and recover the private key. A verifiable breach triggers immediate collateral slashing; the ridge of safeguards must hold even at the zenith of traffic.
